title: Every contact Email Studio may market to carries a permission record: where and when they said yes, and the wording they saw

source.ref: Contact, funnel and tracking audit 2026-11-19 (project thread: Plan a permission-first contact system, report https://claude.ai/artifact/3sCikNdCHC9khmwCJbubfk)

detail: Wave 2 of the permission-first contact plan. Resend's Acceptable Use Policy requires explicit opt-in and names 'assumed until they unsubscribe' as not consent. EMAIL-082 (#5380) stopped brand campaigns mailing the 511 imported contacts unless subscribed, but nothing records how a contact came to be subscribed. Work: a permission record per contact (source, captured_at, page or form, the consent wording shown), written by /subscribe confirm, /start, /join and the Space sign-up forms, and read by the Email Studio audience before a contact counts as mailable. Needs a migration (additive, through the serial gate in docs/DATABASE.md). Filed 2026-11-20 by the verification sweep: the plan named this id but no row existed.

verify.note: Fails until a migration stores a per-contact permission record and lib/email-studio reads it when it builds an audience.
